title: Strengthening the OSCE’s Climate Security Agenda
excerpt: This paper analyses the key strengths and weaknesses of the Organ­ization for Security and Co-oper­ation in Europe’s (OSCE) current approach to climate change and security. Based on this analysis, it outlines five areas that provide concrete entry points to strengthen the OSCE’s work and prepare the organ­ization for a drastically changing security landscape.
